title: 校准选择性事实核查：基于证据链评估
summary: 提出证据链评估（ECE）框架，允许模型在证据不足时弃权而非强制二选一。在ECE-Bench上，标准准确率91.6%，覆盖率93.7%，选择性准确率97.8%。弃权案例集中在低可靠性证据场景，可作为安全机制处理认知薄弱证据。
summary_en: Proposes Evidence Chain Evaluation (ECE), a selective fact-checking framework that allows abstention when evidence is weak. Achieves 91.6% accuracy, 93.7% coverage, and 97.8% selective accuracy on ECE-Bench. Abstention cases concentrate in low-reliability evidence settings, serving as a safety mechanism.
